title: Associativity of the fixed section localization tensorator
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring and assume HasDerivedCategory for the section-module category over every scheme. Fix a scheme T and give its derived section-module category the fixed transported monoidal structure derivedMonoidal Λ T. Let Q denote cochain localization and s(P,Q)=modelTensor Λ T P Q, with the definitions of def-pd-section-resolving-oplax-constraint-data. For every three unbounded section complexes P,Q,H, the equation α(QP,QQ,QH)≫(QP◁s(Q,H))≫s(P,Q⊗H) = (s(P,Q)▷QH)≫s(P⊗Q,H)≫Q(α(P,Q,H)) holds, with composition in Lean order. No scheme morphism, tensor-pullback arrow or resolving assumption occurs.

proof.text: Apply the proved section_cochain_monoidal_data to obtain the strong monoidal termwise section equivalence with exactly cochainTensorComparison as oplax tensorator.

Extract the derived section equivalence oplax structure from ConstraintCondition in section_kflat_tensor_comparison. Its unit is the identity and its tensorators are the invertible components of tensorComparison, so it is strong monoidal. Transfer this structure to the fixed derivedMonoidal structure using TensorFunctorTransport.monoidal_eq. The composite of internal localization and this strong equivalence is lax monoidal. Transfer its lax structure across the strong cochain section equivalence to section localization. The localization-factor isomorphism is monoidal: transport across the counit isomorphism and use naturality plus the equivalence triangle identity for the unit.

Apply the generic monoidal_square to the monoidal localization-factor isomorphism. Its equation and qTensorArrow_normalization have the same right side. Cancel the invertible tensorComparison component and tensor of localization-factor components to identify qTensor with the transferred lax tensorator on termwise internal images. Naturality along the cochain equivalence counit and cancellation of its invertible tensor components extend the equality to all complex pairs. Rewrite the four modelTensor occurrences by this equality and apply the lax monoidal associativity axiom. This also covers zero complexes, zero coefficients and empty sites without inverting any modelTensor component.

lean.statement:
theorem section_localization_associativity (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q H : CochainComplex (modules Λ T) ℤ) :
    letI := derivedMonoidal Λ T
    (α_ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj H)).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ◁ modelTensor Λ T Q H ≫ modelTensor Λ T P (Q ⊗ H) =
      modelTensor Λ T P Q ▷ DerivedCategory.Q.obj H ≫ modelTensor Λ T (P ⊗ Q) H ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (α_ P Q H).hom
